compositionFeatures.shell: the product frame: it composes Evry, feedback, notifications, settings and wiki into every product page, so no feature imports it

compositionRoots.apps/web/src/app/api/cron/jobs/route.ts: the cron dispatcher runs every feature's scheduled job from one route
compositionRoots.apps/web/src/server/evry/index.ts: Evry runtime wiring: it mounts the feature reads Evry answers from
compositionRoots.apps/web/src/server/evry/native.ts: Evry's native port calls each feature's commands
compositionRoots.apps/web/src/server/jobs/scheduled.ts: the scheduler runs every feature's scheduled step

exceptions.reason: the wiki route returns the crawler preview without the frame, so it wraps itself in ProductFrameLayout instead of using a layout

platformFolders.evry: the Evry runtime composition: HTTP wiring, native port and worker
platformFolders.identity: Better Auth, which every request reads
platformFolders.invitations: invitation tokens identity, organizations and Evry share
platformFolders.jobs: the queue, mail, scheduler, webhook and purge jobs every feature uses
platformFolders.mail: mail transport and capture every sender goes through
platformFolders.platform: the HTTP boundary, database and webhook helpers every route uses

thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/access/: a landing-marketing owner-class page that composes the marketing site
thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/global-error.tsx: Next renders it without any layout, so it holds its own markup
thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx: the root layout holds the document shell, fonts and metadata
thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/oversight/: a landing-marketing owner-class page that composes the marketing site
thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/page.tsx: a landing-marketing owner-class page that composes the marketing site
thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/privacy/: a landing-marketing owner-class page that composes the marketing site
thickRoutes.apps/web/src/app/terms/: a landing-marketing owner-class page that composes the marketing site

kernel.access: the authority kernel: session, viewer and pipeline checks every module runs before it reads or writes
kernel.mail-recipients: the pure recipient rule every module that sends mail applies first
kernel.operations: the write kernel: canonical operations and audited writes every module commits through

kernel.common: shared values, time, write and link shapes every contract module builds on

kernel.adapters/native: the native-port kernel every adapter group writes and checks seats through
kernel.catalog: the catalog that lists every adapter group's reads and commands
kernel.context: the turn context every adapter reads
kernel.conversations: conversation storage the runtime and adapters share
kernel.execution: the reviewed-change executor the runtime and adapters share
kernel.index: the package entry the app imports the runtime through
kernel.proposals: proposal storage the runtime and adapters share
kernel.runtime: the turn runtime the adapters plug into
